2607.17136.title: Teach it to stop, not just to click
2607.17136.paper_summary: Agentic computer-use RL is reported in single runs, and those numbers mislead. Using verifier-guided repair of a 35B computer-use agent (CUA) across five oracle-graded environments, we show a repaired policy's success rate is dominated by upstream variance: a variance-components decomposition across three cells (crossed data-draw $\times$ seed grid, bootstrap CIs) finds evaluation variance negligible ($σ_{\mathrm{eval}} \approx 0$) and the training-seed effect small everywhere ($\leq 10\%$); instead it splits between the data draw and run-to-run nondeterminism, the data draw's share rising to dominant ($48\%$) on the hardest cell. There the run-to-run distribution is bimodal (Hartigan dip $p=0.07$, $k=10$), so a single run has roughly a 30% chance of the failure mode and mean$\pm$std is the wrong summary. On that footing, two findings hold. First, repairability is two-tier in how constrained the corrective action is: a single fixed token installs reliably (done-detection $0.97\pm0.06$), while open-ended corrections are only partial -- spatial-coordinate clicks (grounding $0.53\pm0.35$) and a generative field-fill ($0.14\pm0.04$). Second, the frame-level repair transfers to task success only when the corrective action is the task's sole remaining blocker (LinkedIn 8/20 vs. base 0/15, Fisher $p=0.006$). We caught two of our own over-claims -- a sample-efficiency curve and a 'grounding cannot be bought' boundary -- only by replicating across seeds; a stress test makes the stakes external: a single-run improvement of the size this field publishes would have the wrong sign roughly one-third of the time in a comparable regime. We release a library (cua_reliability) for routine k-seed reporting. The apparatus is, to our knowledge, the first multimodal segment-aggregated on-policy self-distillation (SA-OPSD) update on a real 35B CUA policy.
2607.17136.paper_summary_zh: 代理電腦使用強化學習（RL）在單次運行中報告，而這些數字會誤導人。通過在五個由神諭評分的環境中使用驗證者引導的修復一個35B電腦使用代理（CUA），我們顯示修復後的策略成功率受到上游變異的主導：對三個單元進行的變異成分分解（交叉數據抽樣 $\times$ 隨機種子網格，自助法置信區間）發現評估變異微不足道（$σ_{\mathrm{eval}} \approx 0$），而訓練種子效應在各處都很小（$\leq 10\%$）；相反，它在數據抽樣和運行到運行的非確定性之間分裂，數據抽樣的份額在最難的單元上上升到主導（$48\%$）。在那裡，運行到運行的分布是雙峰的（Hartigan dip $p=0.07$, $k=10$），因此單次運行大約有30%的機會出現失敗模式，而平均$\pm$標準差是錯誤的總結。在這種情況下，有兩個發現成立。首先，修復能力是兩級的，取決於修正行動的約束程度：單個固定標記可靠地安裝（完成檢測 $0.97\pm0.06$），而開放式修正僅為部分 -- 空間坐標點擊（基礎 $0.53\pm0.35$）和生成場填充（$0.14\pm0.04$）。其次，框架級別的修復僅在修正行動是任務唯一剩餘障礙時才會轉移到任務成功（LinkedIn 8/20 對比基準 0/15，Fisher $p=0.006$）。我們僅通過在隨機種子間複製，捕捉到我們自己的兩個過度聲明 -- 一個樣本效率曲線和一個“基礎無法購得”的邊界；壓力測試使風險外部化：在可比較的範疇中，這個領域發布的單次運行改進大約有三分之一的時間會有錯誤的符號。我們發布了一個庫（cua_reliability）以進行常規的k種子報告。據我們所知，該設備是第一個在真實的35B CUA策略上進行的多模態段聚合的在線自我蒸餾（SA-OPSD）更新。
